summary: Iteration-13 end-to-end testing of the D-ID talking-head avatar flow + regression for Personas/BrandKit/Letters/Heirs/Buy/Skills. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS (107s, including a real D-ID render completing in ~95s with .mp4 result_url). Frontend Twin page validated: session-cookie auth works, /twin loads, user message streams to assistant reply, twin-play-video button fires POST /api/avatar/talk → loading indicator 'rendering your face speaking…' appears → polls /api/avatar/talks/{id} every 2s → <video data-testid='twin-video-1'> rendered with valid D-ID S3 src (https://d-id-talks-prod.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/...). twin-voice-toggle still toggles, twin-speak-{idx} still present. Settings page avatar URL input + 'Save photo URL' button confirmed: PUT /api/avatar/source-url → 200, value persists across reload. Regression: /personas, /brand, /letters, /heirs, /buy, /skills all render with 0 real console errors; /buy shows the $79 Heirloom Lifetime card and Stripe-form.
action_items: None blocking. D-ID flow is fully functional end-to-end (backend create+poll, frontend play-video button, video element renders, Settings URL save persists).
critical_code_review_comments: avatar.py::create_talk uses Basic auth header constructed from D_ID_API_KEY (already in `user:key` format in env) — works correctly with D-ID's /talks endpoint. Good.
avatar.py::create_talk swallows the user's stitch/fluent config — fine for v1 but consider exposing in TalkReq for power users.
avatar.py::poll_talk writes `result_url` only when present (`if result_url:`), so partial polls don't overwrite a finished record back to null — good.
avatar.py::set_source_url ALLOWS empty string (clears the url, line 156 only validates non-empty strings). Confirmed by test_put_empty_url_is_accepted_as_clear. Intentional clear path — good.
avatar.py::create_talk has timeout=30s; on a slow D-ID upstream this could 502 the client. Current behaviour observed: actual create returns in <2s consistently. Acceptable.
Twin.jsx::playAsVideo polls 60×2s=120s with try/catch on transient poll errors (continue) — robust. Confirmed working in browser test.

Twin.jsx::playAsVideo only attached on assistant messages with `!m.action` — correct (skill/music chips replace the video button). Note: this means if a future feature adds another action.kind, the play-as-video button silently disappears. Consider explicit !m.action || m.action.kind === 'none'.

Twin.jsx: pollErr inside the for-loop is caught and `continue`s, but on the FIRST attempt this means a 401 (e.g., bad session) would silently loop for 120s before showing 'timed out'. Acceptable for now since session auth is required to reach this page, but a single non-2xx response could be surfaced faster.

Settings.jsx: avatar URL input + 'Save photo URL' button works and persists. Consider adding data-testid='settings-avatar-url-input' and data-testid='settings-avatar-save' to make automation more robust (currently relying on placeholder/text matching).
Regression pages (Personas/Brand/Letters/Heirs/Buy/Skills) load with 0 console errors against the real backend — no regressions from the D-ID changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Twin /twin video render, voice toggle, speak button, Settings save/persist, and 6 regression pages all verified.

seed_data_creation: Two test users seeded directly in mongosh per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. User A was further updated with onboarded=true + onboarding_complete=true + preferred_name='Avatar Test A' so the SPA doesn't redirect to /onboarding/* before reaching /twin. Avatar source URL was set by the test itself via PUT /api/avatar/source-url to a D-ID Default Presenter image. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: D-ID flow lives at /app/backend/routers/avatar.py (prefix /api/avatar). Real D-ID renders take ~60-100s and DO complete reliably — pytest deadline is 120s, frontend polling cap is 120s. test_iteration13_avatar.py expects two pre-seeded users; if their sessions are GC'd, re-mint via the mongosh snippet in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and update TEST_TOKEN_A/USER_A/TEST_TOKEN_B/USER_B env vars (or rely on the hardcoded defaults — they're persistent in test_database). To reach /twin in the browser, the test user MUST have onboarded=true OR the SPA will redirect to /onboarding/name. /api/avatar/source-upload is intentionally a 501 stub — do NOT mark this as a bug. Frontend Twin.jsx wires playAsVideo to messages where !m.action, so to test play-video the seeded conversation must produce a plain assistant reply (no music intent, no skill trigger).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs in iteration-13 surface. Earlier iteration-12 noted MagicLink auth-refresh flash issue — NOT retested here (out of scope). Initial Playwright run failed because the test user lacked onboarded=true (SPA redirected to /onboarding/name); fixed by updating db.users.{onboarded:true, onboarding_complete:true} before /twin navigation. The real network errors logged in console (401 + ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED) were transient SSE connection cycles during the streaming response, NOT broken endpoints — confirmed because the streamed reply rendered fully and the subsequent /api/avatar/talk request succeeded.
